texts.zh: 从外表上看，[From.GetName]只是颗普通的白矮星，但这颗恒星却隐藏着大秘密。[Root.GetName]船员在研究了[From.GetName]的脉动之后发现这颗恒星几乎是由结晶碳构成的。当恒星冷却下来后，这个巨大的水晶格子就形成了，这是该恒星气态内核随时间的推移而不断增长所导致的。[From.GetName]可以说是取之不尽用之不竭的钻石宝库，它在氧气和氦气的白色帐幕后闪闪发光。
texts.en: While on the surface [From.GetName] appears to be an ordinary white dwarf, the star hides an intriguing secret. By studying [From.GetName]'s pulsations, the [Root.GetName] crew has discovered its composition to be almost entirely crystallized carbon. This astronomical crystal lattice seems to have formed as the star cooled, originating in its gas-fusing core and growing outward over time. [From.GetName] is a diamond of cosmological proportions, glinting behind a white veil of oxygen and helium.

summary.text:
# 超重脉冲 / Heavy Pulse

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar）

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。调查无战略资源的F型恒星（白矮星外观）时可能生成（2级，权重1），且有 null_spawn_chance 0.5，即被选中后仍有50%不生成。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn when surveying an F-class star without strategic resources (level 2, weight 1); null_spawn_chance 0.5 means it still fails to appear half the time when picked.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.140“宇宙级钻石”：这颗恒星几乎完全由结晶碳构成，是一颗宇宙尺度的钻石。恒星获得物理学矿藏（清除原有采矿矿藏），并记录标本 cosmic_diamond_fragment。

distar.140 "Cosmic Diamond": the star is almost entirely crystallised carbon — a diamond of cosmic size. The star gains a physics deposit (mining deposits are cleared) and the specimen cosmic_diamond_fragment is recorded.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异的选项。
